title: Shortest Unsorted Continuous Subarray
notes:
Task and method: O(n)
Invariant: The stored counts, traversal, or DP state summarizes the input processed so far.
Edge cases: Use the published example and empty/minimal inputs where allowed.
code:
class Solution:
 def findUnsortedSubarray(self,nums):
  n=len(nums);l=0
  while l<n-1 and nums[l]<=nums[l+1]:l+=1
  if l==n-1:return 0
  r=n-1
  while r>0 and nums[r-1]<=nums[r]:r-=1
  lo,hi=min(nums[l:r+1]),max(nums[l:r+1])
  while l>0 and nums[l-1]>lo:l-=1
  while r<n-1 and nums[r+1]<hi:r+=1
  return r-l+1
space_complexity: Linear scans find and extend the minimum unsorted interval.
